title: Grilled Fish Kebabs with Egyptian Flair
description: A flavorful and healthy dish featuring fish kebabs marinated in a zesty Egyptian-inspired sauce, served with a side of roasted vegetables.

ingredients.name: Vegetables for skewers (bell peppers, onions, cherry tomatoes)

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together zesty Egyptian marinade ingredients: lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper.
3. Add fish fillets to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Thread vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
5. Brush vegetables with roasted vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
6. Grill fish kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. Grill vegetable skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until tender.
8. Serve fish kebabs with roasted vegetables and pita bread or couscous on the side.
9. Garnish with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
